metadata.probe_method: Load-only kernels in the GemvKernel launch shape (16 rows per wave, 8-wave blocks, production rotation and one-super-block prefetch), checksummed loads, rotating weight copies totaling >=128 MiB, median of nine timed samples of 64 launches. Full kernel: HEAD vs a slab-walk rewrite in one binary, five to seven alternating A/B rounds of four copy rotations; correctness gate gemma4.projection_ops (width invariance + FP64 oracle) on the rewritten tree; cold op-test medians of two runs (40 iterations each, 256-MiB rotation).
metadata.harness_note: A two-arm one-binary A/B whose arms include copies of the same headers must give every copy a unique include guard: with the stock guard, the second arm's pack header is suppressed and its PackKernel compiles against the first arm's pack layout - output values silently change, timings do not. Root cause and evidence: include-guard collision confirmed by -save-temps inspection and HIP dispatch traces (the correct kernel names dispatch; the pack helper body is the base one).

load_only_probes_us_and_gbs.note: P1 production per-lane row loads; P2 cooperative 4x128B full lines; P3 16x32B uniform pairs; P4 8x64B runs; P6 gridDim.y k-splits (S); P9 AR-GEMV structure replica (4 rows/wave, contiguous slices); P11 shared-16-row contiguous slabs (S waves); P12 slabs + full-line phase loads; P8 linear stream control.

slab_kernel_ab_delta_percent.description: 16-row blocks x 8 waves, wave w reduces contiguous super-block slab w; per-lane loads unchanged; pack fragment-major so A fragments load contiguously across lanes; per-slab partials summed in slab order; projection_ops passes (37/37, FP64 <= 9.1e-8).

op_test_cold_delta_percent_one_five_sixt.note: Medians of two full gemma4.projection_ops runs per arm, all 37 shapes; positive means the slab kernel is slower.

verdict: Rejected. The walk-geometry gain (209 -> 216-225 GB/s load-side at eight contiguous slabs) cannot pay for the per-wave activation-tile reads (~3.5x the weight bytes through L2 versus one shared LDS staging). Only 5376x16384 at one to five rows improves (-0.8 to -2.4%). The load-pattern and occupancy levers for item 1 are now measured dead; what remains is structural to 16-row B tiles plus the ~7% math term.
